## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A single-fascicle early-Qīng liturgical manual by **Hóngzàn** ([弘贊](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%BC%98%E8%B4%8A), 1612–1686) for the formal worship of *śarīra*-stūpas. Author signature: *Yuèdōng Dǐnghúshān shāmén shì Hóngzàn Zàishēn biān* 粵東鼎湖山沙門釋　弘贊在犙　編.

**Abstract**

The *Lǐ shèlìtǎ yíshì* is part of Hóngzàn's **liturgical-procedural trilogy** for Cantonese-Buddhist devotional practice, alongside [KR6k0239](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6k/KR6k0239) *Lǐ Fó yíshì* (Buddhaveneration) and [KR6k0240](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6k/KR6k0240) *Gòng zhūtiān kēyí* (offering to the *devas*). It is a polemically-conscious work: Hóngzàn complains that "in the present time those who do reverence do not consult the canonical institution and contravene the standards; they only know how to call the names but do not know how to praise the virtues" (今時禮敬。罔諳教法。多乖儀則。唯知稱名。不曉讚德), citing the *Běnxíng* on the superiority of even one four-line *zàn* over years of material support, as the work's polemical justification. Composition is bracketed by Hóngzàn's mature career; `notBefore`–`notAfter` are 1660–1686.
